Accessibility statement

Riverside Plumbing wants everyone to be able to book a plumber, whatever technology they use. We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines version 2.2 at Level AA, and we test the site regularly with automated tools and with a keyboard and screen reader.

What we have done

  • Every image carries a text alternative, or is marked as decorative.
  • The whole site can be operated with a keyboard alone, and focus is always visible.
  • Text and background colours meet the contrast ratios in the guidelines.
  • Pages work at 200% zoom and reflow on a narrow phone screen.

Known limitations

Our online booking calendar is provided by a third party and we are working with them on its keyboard support. If it gives you any trouble, call us and we will book the appointment for you.

Tell us about a problem

If any part of this site is hard to use, please call (217) 555-0142 or email office@riversideplumbing.example. We aim to respond within two working days and to fix the problem, and we will always give you another way to get what you needed in the meantime.
